name: Unbound Solar
old_description: Unbound Solar is a distributor of solar equipment. Offers a wide range of solar panels and complete solar kits for residential and commercial installations.
about:
Unbound Solar is based in Fullerton, California, and was founded in 2004. The company operates as a distributor of solar equipment, providing panels, kits, and inverters for residential and commercial installations.

The company designs and ships complete solar systems tailored to customer goals and property specifics, offering professional-grade equipment selected for performance and reliability. Services include custom system design, permitting and interconnection assistance, and lifetime technical support. With a team of 10–49 employees, Unbound Solar has supported over 20,000 installed systems and maintains a 97% permit approval rate.

Unbound Solar serves homeowners pursuing self-installation, as well as builders and professional installers through a dedicated partner program. Its residential and commercial customers rely on the company’s engineering expertise and planning tools—such as cost, battery, and production calculators—to size and specify systems.

The business emphasizes a “design, ship, and support” model that aims to give self-installers the savings of DIY without the guesswork, backed by two decades of solar experience and ongoing expert guidance for the life of each system.
